_comment: REV-179: copy this file to model-standard.config.json (same folder) and edit for your organization. check_model_standard looks for that exact filename by default; without it, only the structural checks below run (no naming rules).

typeNamePattern._comment: Regex source (JS RegExp), per Revit category (OST_ name) or "*" for every category, tested against type names.

familyNamePattern._comment: Same idea, tested against family names. Skipped for system types (walls, floors) — they have no family.
